lines.text: Try reading this while counting backward.
In a driving simulator, people had to brake for red lights.
Then they did it again while chatting on a phone.
The red lights they missed more than doubled.
Hands-free was no better. Listening to the radio barely mattered.
Your brain doesn't multitask. It switches.
And every switch has a cost.

post.title: Your Brain Can't Actually Multitask #shorts
post.description: Talking while driving isn't harmless multitasking. In Strayer & Johnston (2001), people in a driving simulator missed more than twice as many red lights while on a phone call, hands-free or not, while listening to the radio didn't reliably hurt. #psychology #multitasking #focus
